THE AFFINE NULL HOLDS EXACTLY WHERE IT IS PREDICTED TO.  Every one of the 36 CU-JOINT seed pairs -- both seed sets a coset of ONE order-3 subgroup H -- is evaluated on its own field and every one has Stab containing H: 291600 of 291600 schedules, 100 per cent.  This is the U4 adjudication's mechanism n = c + m*1_S read as a prediction and confirmed; the crystallinity of these schedules carries NO emergence information

AND IT HOLDS NOWHERE ELSE AMONG THE COSET SEEDS.  Every one of the 108 CU-SPLIT seed pairs -- both seed sets cosets, of DIFFERENT subgroups -- is evaluated on its own field and every one has trivial stabilizer: two lines of different directions meet in exactly one point, so the field takes the value 2 at a single site, and no order-3 period can carry a value that occurs once.  0 of 874800 schedules crystalline

CRYSTALLINITY IS NOT CONFINED TO THE CONSTRUCTOR-INHERITED LOCUS.  216 of the 6912 beyond-coset seed pairs -- at least one seed set NOT a coset of any order-3 subgroup -- carry a nontrivial translation stabilizer, and each is verified on its own field: 1749600 of 55987200 beyond-coset schedules, a rate of 1/32, realizing all four order-3 subgroups ['<(0,1)>', '<(1,0)>', '<(1,1)>', '<(1,2)>'].  The mechanism is measured too: the field takes the value 1 on a union of two H-cosets and 0 on the third while NEITHER seed set is an H-coset, so the period is a property of the PAIR and not of either seed

THE CARRIER OF THE PERIOD IS THE SUM, NOT EITHER SUMMAND -- AND IT IS A COSET UNION AT EVERY CRYSTALLINE PAIR.  For each of the 252 crystalline seed pairs the support of the division field is tested against the cosets of THAT FIELD'S OWN period subgroup: 252 of 252 are exactly a union of them, in two shapes -- 12 pairs with the two seed sets EQUAL, so the field is 2 on one coset and 0 elsewhere, and 240 pairs with the field 1 on two cosets and 0 on the third.  So the affine law n = c + m*1_S is violated NOWHERE in this census: it holds on the UNION of the two seed sets.  What the census measures is that the inherited argument was stated on the wrong variable -- the per-seed locus contains one seventh of the crystallinity it was supposed to explain, and the beyond-coset class carries the other 6/7 -- not that a mechanism outside the affine law exists on this arena.  The mechanism is closed in closed form and needs no census: 4 subgroups x 3 choices of the empty coset x 18 ordered splits of the remaining six sites that are not the two cosets themselves = 216 beyond-coset pairs, and 36 coset-union pairs, 252 in all

AT EVERY BEYOND-COSET CRYSTALLINE PAIR, NEITHER SEED SET IS A LINE AT ALL -- not merely 'not a coset of the period'.  All 216 are checked one by one against the 12 lines of AG(2,3): 0 have a line seed.  The reason is geometric and not statistical: a coset of a DIFFERENT order-3 subgroup meets each coset of the period exactly once, so it cannot sit inside the union of two of them

THE PERIOD AND THE DIAGONAL LINK COUNT ARE SEPARATELY CARRIED AND NEITHER DETERMINES THE OTHER -- BUT THEY ARE NOT INDEPENDENT, AND THE DEPARTURE IS EXACTLY AT THE DIAGONAL.  The MARGINAL is exactly uniform: [510300] crystalline schedules in each of the four period directions.  The JOINT is not: the diagonal link count is populated at 4661/4725 of crystalline schedules in each of the three non-diagonal directions but at 101/105 when the period IS the diagonal.  Conditionally, among the 40176 crystalline schedules whose diagonal link count is EMPTY, the period is the diagonal at 19440 of them -- 15/31, against 1/4 under independence.  The period is a seed property and the diagonal link count a grouping property; the residual coupling is the transversal constraint between seed sets and groupings, and it is read as nothing else

EVERY NONEMPTY CENSUS STRATUM HAS A MENU-DRIVEN WITNESS.  The 20 nonempty (stabilizer x affine-class x non-degeneracy) strata of the WHOLE family are each given a deterministic representative -- the first in a fixed enumeration, no sampling -- and each representative's record is built by driving the layer's menus: 20 witnesses, every one FORCED (maxhits = 1, no refusal, 6 division events). A single-arbitration re-seating -- moving exactly one division event to another cell of its own conflict group, the smallest edit that stays in the family -- has 12 admissible forms at every schedule (6 arbitrations x 2 alternative seats, each an admissible member of the window in its own right), and at every one of the 540 crystalline window schedules ALL of them destroy the period.  Each schedule is evaluated against its own edits (#87).  The mechanism: the edit changes the field by 1_new - 1_old, and a difference of two distinct point masses is never constant on the cosets of an order-3 subgroup
